zh.title: 易捷航空宣布英國新航線 距離僅149英里
zh.summary: 易捷航空宣布英國新航線 全長149英里 為第二短非離島航線
body: 易捷航空於2026年9月9日宣布，將開通一條全長僅149英里的英國國內航線。此為該航空公司全網路中第二短的航線，且不涉及離島航點。
該航線具體連結的兩座城市暫未於來源中透露，但易捷指出此舉將加強其在英國的區域連通性。提供更多短途旅行選擇。

en.title: easyJet Announces New Extremely Short UK Route of Just 149 Miles
en.summary: easyJet launches new UK route of 149 miles, its second-shortest non-island service
body: easyJet announced on September 9, 2026 that it will launch a new domestic UK route covering just 149 miles. This will be the airline's second-shortest route across its entire network that does not involve islands.

The specific cities connected by the route were not disclosed in the source, but easyJet said the move would strengthen regional connectivity within the United Kingdom and offer additional short-haul travel options.
